name: KIC 8636104
description: A red-clump giant burning helium in its core in the Kepler field, 11.1 solar radii and 1.03 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 8636104 (Gold): Radius (Mosser scale, solar radii) 11.1161 +/- 0.2063

mass.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 8636104 (Gold): Mass (Mosser scale, solar masses) 1.0267 +/- 0.0422

temperature.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 8636104 (Gold): APOGEE effective temperature (K) 4821.4775 +/- 52.388

gravity.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 8636104 (Gold): Asteroseismic log g 2.3603 +/- 0.0044

color.reason: The star lies in the Galactic plane hundreds to thousands of parsecs away, where interstellar dust reddens its spectra, and the colour routes do not remove it; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red-clump giant in the Kepler field, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations give 1.03 solar masses and 11.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,821 K at its surface.
